## Executed native asset experiment
Generated actual glTF 2.0 binary head-breath-rig-NO_RELEASE.glb, 1,750,124 bytes; 16,971 vertices / 27,372 triangles, original texture images preserved. SHA256 9053b046eafd48e9cd5dd0acd0961a5c25b472c0935030da13f531ab62300832. Native two-joint hierarchy BodyRoot/HeadPivot, JOINTS_0 uint16 and WEIGHTS_0 float32, inverse bind matrices, two named animation clips (HeadYaw_18deg_test, ChestBreathTest), one true POSITION morph target. No new primitive proxy. Root rest identity; head pivot [0,.10,-.035], y-up. Five keys yaw 0,+18,0,-18,0 degrees at 0,1,2,3,4 s; chest keys 0,1,0,1,0 at 0,1.2,2.4,3.6,4.8 s. Weight sum max error zero. 3,965 vertices >.99 head influence; 10,134 <.01. Independent CPU pose evaluation used actual asset accessors, not separate geometry. Core executed calculations:
```python
t=np.clip((v[:,1]-.025)/.20,0,1); w=t*t*(3-2*t)
pivot=np.array([0,.10,-.035])
mask=np.exp(-((v[:,1]+.105)/.16)**2)*np.clip((v[:,1]+.34)/.12,0,1)*(1-w)
delta=np.zeros_like(v); delta[:,0]=v[:,0]*.035*mask
delta[:,2]=(v[:,2]-.015)*.025*mask
v0=v+delta*breath
v1=(1-w[:,None])*v0+w[:,None]*((v0-pivot)@R.T+pivot)
```
